_comment: WP03 weapon art spec. Prompts are the ASSET_MANIFEST prompts, extended for era detail and a fixed orientation (muzzle to the image left). Used by wpn_fal.py (fal jobs) and bl_weapon.py (Blender processing). Lengths are real overall lengths in metres.
tail_side: exact left side profile with the muzzle pointing to the left, camera perpendicular, no perspective distortion, entire object visible, centered, filling about 90% of the frame width. Pure seamless white background, soft even diffuse studio lighting, minimal specular highlights, only a faint contact shadow, everything in sharp focus, extremely detailed, museum catalog reference photo. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no markings, no logos, no serial numbers, no insignia, no flags, no hands, no other objects.
tail_34: 3/4 elevated view, camera perpendicular, no perspective distortion, entire object visible, centered, filling about 80% of the frame. Pure seamless white background, soft even diffuse studio lighting, minimal specular highlights, only a faint contact shadow, everything in sharp focus, extremely detailed, museum catalog reference photo. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no markings, no logos, no serial numbers, no insignia, no flags, no hands, no other objects.
edit_nomag: Remove the magazine from this weapon. Show exactly the same weapon with its magazine taken out and the empty magazine well opening visible underneath the receiver. Keep everything else identical: same design, same parts, same materials and wear, same angle, same size, same position in the frame, same lighting and the same pure white background. No text, no markings, no hands.
edit_magonly: Remove the weapon completely and keep only its detachable magazine. The magazine must stay exactly as it is in the photo: identical design, shape, ribs, colour, finish and wear, the same angle, the same size and the same position in the frame. Pure seamless white background, soft even studio lighting, only a faint contact shadow. No text, no markings, nothing else in the image.
edit_right: Show this exact same weapon from its other side: exact right side profile with the muzzle pointing to the right, camera perpendicular, no perspective distortion. Identical design, proportions, materials, colours and wear, the same scale and the same pure white background and soft even studio lighting. Show the parts that belong on the right side of this weapon. No text, no markings, no hands, no other objects.

WPN_COMMANDO.name: Commando
WPN_COMMANDO.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a 1970s XM177E2 / CAR-15 "Commando" carbine of the Vietnam era: short 11.5-inch barrel ending in a long cylindrical moderator-style flash hider, triangular front sight base with sight post, slim round ribbed handguard, A1-style upper receiver with a triangular fixed carry handle and rear aperture sight, forward assist, slim A1 pistol grip, collapsible two-position aluminium stock extended, worn matte black anodised finish with silvered edges and light desert dust, curved 30-round aluminium magazine inserted, no sling, no optic, no rails, no attachments,

WPN_HUSHPUPPY.name: HushPuppy
WPN_HUSHPUPPY.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a 1960s Smith & Wesson Mk 22 Mod 0 "Hush Puppy" style 9mm suppressed pistol based on the Model 39: blued steel slide with a slide-lock lever, exposed round hammer, alloy frame, black grips, long matte black cylindrical suppressor threaded onto the barrel, worn blued finish with honest edge wear, 8-round magazine fully inserted,

WPN_RPK.name: RPK
WPN_RPK.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a 1970s RPK-pattern light machine gun: AKM-style stamped steel receiver, long heavy barrel with a folded bipod clamped near the muzzle, front sight post, tangent rear sight, laminated wood club-foot buttstock, wooden handguard and pistol grip, worn blued steel with honest wear, 75-round round drum magazine inserted, no sling, no optic,

WPN_AKMS.name: AKMS
WPN_AKMS.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of an AKMS-pattern rifle: stamped steel receiver, slant muzzle brake, front sight post, laminated wood handguard and brown pistol grip, under-folding stamped steel stock unfolded and extended, plum-coloured bakelite 30-round magazine inserted, worn blued steel, no sling, no optic,

WPN_SVD.name: SVD
WPN_SVD.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of an SVD-pattern semi-automatic marksman rifle: long slim barrel with a slotted flash hider, laminated wood skeleton thumbhole stock with a cheek rest, wooden handguard, long telescopic sight with a rubber eyecup on a side mount, 10-round box magazine inserted, worn blued steel,

WPN_RPG7.name: RPG7
WPN_RPG7.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of an RPG-7 pattern shoulder-fired launcher: steel launch tube with two wooden heat guards, pistol grip with trigger guard, folding iron sights, flared rear venturi nozzle, loaded with a PG-7 pattern rocket whose olive drab conical warhead protrudes from the front of the tube, worn olive drab paint and blued steel, warhead pointing to the left,

WPN_RPG7_ROCKET.name: RPG7_Rocket
WPN_RPG7_ROCKET.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a single PG-7 pattern rocket-propelled grenade projectile: olive drab conical warhead with a pointed nose cap, slim steel motor body, small folded tail fins at the rear, worn olive drab paint, nose pointing to the left,

WPN_DSHK.name: DShK
WPN_DSHK.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a DShK-pattern 12.7 mm heavy machine gun on a short pintle mount: long finned heavy barrel with a large muzzle brake, flat steel gun shield, spade grips with a butterfly trigger, ladder rear sight, belt-feed cover on top, worn olive paint over steel,

WPN_M60D.name: M60D
WPN_M60D.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of an M60D-pattern helicopter door machine gun: spade grips with a butterfly trigger instead of a stock, ring-and-bead aircraft sight, long barrel with a flash hider and carrying handle, feed tray cover with a short belt of linked brass 7.62 mm rounds hanging from the left side, pintle mount adapter underneath, worn matte black parkerized steel,

WPN_M67.name: M67
WPN_M67.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of an M67 pattern fragmentation grenade: smooth olive drab steel sphere, steel fuze assembly on top with the curved spoon (safety lever) running down the side, safety pin with a steel pull ring, worn paint with small chips,

WPN_KNIFE.name: Knife
WPN_KNIFE.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a 1980s military fighting knife: parkerized dark grey clip-point steel blade with a sharpened edge, straight steel crossguard, stacked leather-washer handle, steel pommel, honest wear, blade pointing to the left,

WPN_SMOKE_GRENADE.name: SmokeGrenade
WPN_SMOKE_GRENADE.prompt: Photorealistic studio product photograph of a cylindrical olive drab M18-pattern smoke grenade standing upright: plain sheet steel can with a single plain white painted band around the middle, emission holes on the top, steel fuze assembly with a spoon (safety lever) and a pull ring, no stencils,
